name: dsh-ui-font-plus
description: DSH Web GUI font engine + settings page, with the code-font axis wired up: the global size slider scales body text AND code blocks / inline code / tool output (upstream dsh-ui-font only rewrites the var() fallback, so code stayed put). Also: runtime discovery of every client plugin's styles, declaration-point pick-to-tune selector (design tokens / per-rule px), configurable hotkeys (picker / font size +/-1), system font enumeration via sfnt name-table parsing, DSH settings.yaml persistence (with localStorage fallback for older installs and offline reads), manual refresh (no polling).
